about: C3b the jank walk on foot by his wreck, by real input: out of the car (E), then walk into his car's middle, into the crouched man, into my own car's middle, out to the river's rail and along the road; every 100 ms the eye is checked against the two cars' boxes and the man (nothing passes through anything). Then back in by E at the door. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_jank_walk.json

steps.eval: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; window.__jw = { inside: [], n: 0, minMan: 9 }; setInterval(() => { const C2 = G.scenes.ctx && G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; if (!C2 || C2.phase !== 'out') return; const e = G.controller.pos; window.__jw.n++; for (const v of [C2.my, C2.his]) { const l = v.local(e); if (Math.abs(l.x) < v.spec.halfL && Math.abs(l.z) < v.spec.halfW) window.__jw.inside.push(v.kind + ' ' + l.x.toFixed(2) + ',' + l.z.toFixed(2)); } if (C2.manAt) window.__jw.minMan = Math.min(window.__jw.minMan, Math.hypot(e.x - C2.manAt.x, e.z - C2.manAt.z)); }, 100); return JSON.stringify({ my: [C.my.pos.x, C.my.pos.z], his: [C.his.pos.x, C.his.pos.z], man: C.manAt, eye: [G.controller.pos.x, G.controller.pos.z] }); })()

steps.look: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase, K = G.controller, t = ([C.his.pos.x, C.his.pos.z]); const want = Math.atan2(-(t[0] - K.pos.x), -(t[1] - K.pos.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - K.yaw), Math.cos(want - K.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / K.sensitivity), 0]; })()
